summary:
Main
Today, the DCE iron ore futures moved strongly today. The most-traded DCE I2609 contract closed at 747.5 yuan/mt, up 0.74%. Spot prices at Qingdao Portrose roughly 5-8 yuan/mt from the previous trading day.
